title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah celebrates auspicious festival of Raksha Bandhan in Ahmedabad with girls from his parliamentary constituency who are suffering from Type-1 diabetes

body_text:
Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah celebrated the auspicious festival of Raksha Bandhan in Ahmedabad with girls from his parliamentary constituency who are suffering from Type-1 diabetes.
Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation in his post on ‘X’ said, Today, in Ahmedabad, I celebrated the auspicious festival of Raksha Bandhan with the daughters in my parliamentary constituency who are suffering from Type-1 diabetes. Children afflicted with Type-1 diabetes require insulin injections for life, which places a significant financial burden on their families. Under the leadership of Modi ji, our government is providing free insulin for life to all such children. This visionary initiative, which even many developed nations are currently striving to implement, is a testament to the Modi government's commitment to the principles of ‘Service, Compassion, and Security’.
आज अहमदाबाद में अपने संसदीय क्षेत्र की टाइप-1 डायबिटीज से पीड़ित बेटियों के साथ रक्षाबंधन का पावन पर्व मनाया। टाइप-1 डायबिटीज से पीड़ित बच्चों को जीवनभर इंसुलिन के इंजेक्शन की आवश्यकता होती है, जो उनके परिवारों पर बड़ा आर्थिक बोझ डालता है। मोदी जी के नेतृत्व में हमारी सरकार… pic.twitter.com/JQCGwPZUD7 — Amit Shah (@AmitShah) August 28, 2026
On this occasion, Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah extended his best wishes to all the girls for the festival of Raksha Bandhan and wished them good health and a bright future.
Under the leadership and guidance of Shri Amit Shah, children aged 0 to 18 years suffering from Type-1 juvenile diabetes in the Gandhinagar parliamentary constituency have been ensured the benefits of the Modi government's visionary initiative. In this direction, an integrated system comprising "screening – diagnosis – insulin/treatment – ​​monitoring – follow-up" has been established to provide lifelong essential insulin to children suffering from Type-1 diabetes in the Gandhinagar Lok Sabha constituency.
Speaking on the occasion, Shri Amit Shah said, “For the Modi government, public service is not merely a responsibility but the guiding principle of compassionate governance.” Only when the health of daughters is secure will the future of the family and society be secure. This initiative to provide free insulin to daughters on the auspicious occasion of Raksha Bandhan also symbolizes our commitment to the protection and health of daughters.
